info.title: API.SH: QS Top Universities
info.description: The QS Top Universities API from API.SH: public QS Top Universities data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The filter values of one QS ranking table: `editions` (years with their paths), `study_levels`, `subjects` (ids for `subject`), `regions` with their `countries` (codes for `country`) and `cities`, `sort_columns` and `indicators` (with their `sort_by` values).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/qs-ranking-filters

parameters.name: ranking
parameters.description: Ranking link, path or id (as in `/qs/v1/rankings`).

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Edition year.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every QS ranking table on TopUniversities, current and past editions: `id`, `title`, `path`, `url`, `year`, `type` (ranking family, e.g. `world-university-rankings`, `university-subject-rankings`, `mba-rankings`) and `latest` (the current edition's path). Filter by text, year or type; `types` lists the families. Pass a `path` or `id` to `/qs/v1/rankings`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/qs-ranking-list

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the title or path, e.g. `computer science`.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Edition year, e.g. `2026`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Ranking family from `types`, e.g. `university-subject-rankings`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One QS ranking table from TopUniversities (topuniversities.com): the QS World University Rankings of any year, the rankings by subject, by region, sustainability, employability, MBA and business masters, best student cities and the others in `/qs/v1/ranking-list`. Each row: `rank`, `rank_display` (e.g. `=36`, `1401+`), `name`, `url`, `country`, `region`, `city`, `logo`, `overall_score`, `indicators` (each indicator's group, id, name, rank and score), `qs_stars`, `more_info`. Filters and sorts are the table's own (values from `/qs/v1/ranking-filters`). `total` is the table's row count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/qs-rankings

parameters.name: ranking
parameters.description: Ranking link or path, e.g. `world-university-rankings/2026`, `university-subject-rankings/computer-science-information-systems`, `sustainability-rankings`, or its id from `/qs/v1/ranking-list`. Default: the latest World University Rankings.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Edition year, e.g. `2025` (picks that year's table of the same ranking).

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Region, e.g. `Europe` or `Asia`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Two-letter country code, lower case, e.g. `gb` (several: comma-separated).

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City, e.g. `London`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search the table by university name, e.g. `tokyo`.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: `rank`, `university`, `overallscore` or an indicator (`indicator_76`, ids in the rows and in `/qs/v1/ranking-filters`).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: `asc` or `desc`.

parameters.name: study_level
parameters.description: Only universities offering a study level: 2 Bachelors, 3 Masters, 4 MBA, 5 PhD.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Only universities offering a subject (subject id from `/qs/v1/ranking-filters`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, default 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page (1-100), default 50.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Universities on TopUniversities matching a name, city or keyword: `name`, `url`, `world_rank`, `programme_count`, `logo`, `country`, `city`, `campuses`, `attributes`, `overview`. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/qs-universities

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: University name, city or keyword, e.g. `oxford`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name to narrow the search, e.g. `Japan`.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, default 1.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Results per page (1-100), default 20.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One university's TopUniversities profile: `name`, `location`, `logo`, `country`, `city`, `about`, `rank_summary`, `attributes` (status, research output, student/faculty ratio, size...), `world_rank`, `rankings` (latest rank in each QS ranking it appears in), `rank_history` (World University Rankings by year), `programmes` (by study level, each with name, department and link), `admission` (test score requirements by level), `students_staff`, `cost_of_living`, `campuses` (address, coordinates, main campus), and `raw`. An unknown university answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/qs-university

parameters.name: university
parameters.description: University link (https://www.topuniversities.com/universities/university-oxford) or its slug, e.g. `university-oxford`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
